decisions.reason: No de novo entry can be submitted. The 100 de novo Fv designs are 257-259 residues against the organisers' 250-residue construct cap. Converting them to VHH would submit a molecule that was never folded, never abguard-checked, and whose paratope was designed against a partner light chain. Submitting a molecule we have no evidence for scores worse on the challenge's own rubric than entering one track honestly, so the optimisation track is the entry by decision, not by omission.
decisions.cost: The de novo track is unentered; it carries half of the track prize (EUR 3000 split evenly).
decisions.would_change_if: A de novo construct under 250 aa with an abguard pass and a fold showing domain IV contacts is produced before the freeze.

construct._note: abguard's 250 aa limit is stated as combined VH + VL, so length_ok is on vh_plus_vl_length. If it is enforced on the whole construct the linker counts too, which is construct_within_limit. Both are here because the rule is ambiguous and the two disagree for long pairs: a 242 aa pair passes on VH+VL and fails at 257 aa with this linker. max_linker_for_limit is the longest linker that satisfies the strict reading. Treat 12 aa as the floor, not a soft preference: a linker of 3-12 residues CANNOT fold into a functional Fv domain and pairs with a second copy into a bivalent diabody instead (PMID 10436086, 12856620), and a linker series measured directly stayed monomeric only above 11 residues (PMID 8577701). On this very target an anti-ErbB2 scFv was turned into a diabody precisely by cutting its linker 15 -> 5 aa, with dissociation up to 15x slower from avidity (PMID 11103810) -- so shortening the linker to fit the limit would buy an SPR number from valency rather than from the design. A pair that leaves less than 12 aa needs Fab format or shorter CDRs, never a shorter linker.

Both are here because the rule is ambiguous and the two disagree for long pairs: a 242 aa pair passes on VH+VL and fails at 257 aa with this linker. max_linker_for_limit is the longest linker that satisfies the strict reading. Treat 12 aa as the floor, not a soft preference: a linker of 3-12 residues CANNOT fold into a functional Fv domain and pairs with a second copy into a bivalent diabody instead (PMID 10436086, 12856620), and a linker series measured directly stayed monomeric only above 11 residues (PMID 8577701). On this very target an anti-ErbB2 scFv was turned into a diabody precisely by cutting its linker 15 -> 5 aa, with dissociation up to 15x slower from avidity (PMID 11103810) -- so shortening the linker to fit the limit would buy an SPR number from valency rather than from the design. A pair that leaves less than 12 aa needs Fab format or shorter CDRs, never a shorter linker.
